div.head: II As 3.2
div.ab: ⁊ eac swylc cynges hordere oððe ure gerefena, hwylc ðara ðeofa gewita wære ðe staledon, beo be ðam ilcan.
⁊ eac swilce cynges hordera oððe ure gerefena, swilc ðære ðeofa gewita wære ðe staledon, beo he be ðam ilcan.
⁊ eac swylce cyninges hordra oððe ure gerefena, hwelc þæra þe þeofa gewita wære þe staledon, beo be þæm ylcan.
Et quicumque hordera regis uel prepositus, qui furi consentaneus erit, similiter reus habebitur (simili sententie subiacebit).
⁊ eac swilce cynges hordera oððe ure gerefena hwylc ðara ðeofa gewita wære ðe staledon, beo he be ðam ilcan.
And in like manner also, any of the royal treasurers or [any] of our reeves who have been accessories to thieves, who have been guilty of stealing, shall suffer the same [penalty].
And likewise any of the king’s treasurers or of our reeves, who has been an accessory of thieves who have committed theft, is to be liable to the same.
Und auch jeder Königskämmerer oder [jeder] unserer Vögte, welcher Mitwisser jener Diebe, die stehlen, wäre, sei unter demselben [Strafgesetz].
And likewise any king's treasurer or [any] of our reeves who was an accessory of those thieves who stole, let him be under the same [penal law].
